subject.title: refactor(auth): harden CLI forwarding proposal boundary

question: Should OpenClaw consolidate this behavior on the existing `CliBackendPlugin.prepareExecution` contract, explicitly replace that API, or close the unused parallel proposal?
rationale: The patch is internally coherent, but choosing a second permanent auth/plugin boundary versus the established execution hook requires maintainer ownership and product/API intent.

options.title: Use `prepareExecution`
options.body: Move the concrete provider behavior onto the existing hook and add focused identity validation there without introducing a second contract.

options.title: Replace the existing API
options.body: Sponsor a deliberate redesign that migrates callers, SDK baselines, docs, compatibility tests, and live proof together rather than landing a parallel helper.

options.title: Close the proposal
options.body: Close this draft if there is no concrete consumer or sponsored replacement plan.

recommendation.title: Use `prepareExecution`
recommendation.body: Move the concrete provider behavior onto the existing hook and add focused identity validation there without introducing a second contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history most strongly connects this person to the existing CLI backend contract and runner integration where the decision belongs.
